"''We get one shot at this. We win, or die trying.''"
"''Every one of us is expendable. If the galaxy is to survive, the Emperor must fall.|Lord Scourge and the Hero, to the rest of their group|}} The '''Dromund Kaas operation''' was a covert mission carried out by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], that saw the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] attack the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The [[Navy/Legends|naval]] assault was but a diversion—while [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] led the Republic Navy in engaging the Imperial [[First Defense Fleet]], a small unit led by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] infiltrated Dromund Kaas with the purpose of confronting the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The Hero had foiled the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] recent [[Emperor's ritual crisis|attempts]] to [[Death/Legends|massacre]] thousands on the planets [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Voss]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], a sacrifice that was necessary to start the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] to consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the Jedi hoped to kill the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] before he could complete his plans. The Hero and a small group of allies fought their way through the Imperial capital of [[Kaas City]] and stole the [[Sith Emperor's shuttle]], in which they [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] to the nearby [[Dark Temple]]. At the temple, they battled their way through the Sith and [[Imperial Guard]]smen who protected the Emperor. The Hero's allies engaged the temple's defenders while the Knight and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] fought the Emperor in the heart of the temple. The Emperor was struck down in battle with the Knight, and although only the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|host body]] for the Emperor's [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] essence was slain, the Jedi and the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at large believed him to be dead. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], long at odds with many of the Empire's policies, claimed the [[Emperor's Fortress]] and declared a [[New Empire]], and the six powerful Sith known as the [[Dread Masters]] decided that they would claim the galaxy for themselves. Although rumors of his death spread, the Empire and the Republic officially kept the Emperor's death a secret until the aftermath of the [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of the planet [[Makeb]] [[3638 BBY|two years later]], when Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] publicly revealed the success of the classified operation. ==Prelude== ===The Emperor's plans=== {{Quote|I am loyal to the Emperor.''"
"''Loyal to the Emperor, or to the Empire? They are two different things.''"
"''What do you mean?''"
"''The Emperor is mad. Unchecked, he will destroy us all.|Scourge learns of the Emperor's crimes from his superior, [[Darth Nyriss]]|''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''}} In [[4999 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] used a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to consume the life of all beings on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nathema]]. The [[Ritual of Nathema|casting]] of the ritual stripped [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself from the entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] every living being on Nathema and allowing Vitiate to consume their combined [[Living Force/Legends|life force]], granting him immense strength in the Force and rendering him [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]]. Now known as the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]], he went on to [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitute]] the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], over which he ruled for well over a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Throughout that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] delved further into the study of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Magic/Legends|magic]], seeking a way to gain even more power.{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Unthinkable Alliance|Tython}} [[File:RevanconfrontsSithEmperor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Revan (pictured) attempted to defeat the Emperor, but Scourge's vision revealed it was the Hero of Tython who would be the one to truly strike down the Sith ruler.]] In [[3950 BBY]], the Emperor was [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|attacked]] by three powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]]—the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Meetra Surik]] and the Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]—and was almost defeated by them. However, during the fight, Scourge had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the future, where he saw [[Hero of Tython|another Jedi]] standing victorious over the Emperor. He chose to betray Revan and Surik in order to ensure that future came to pass, as he understood the threat that the Emperor posed to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As a result, Scourge was appointed as the [[Emperor's Wrath]], the Emperor's personal enforcer, and served the Emperor for the next few [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], while Surik was killed and Revan was captured and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] during the same period. Due to the Emperor's brush with death, he sought out a way to [[Essence transfer|transfer]] his consciousness and powers between host bodies, and the Emperor thereafter used them in order to safeguard his true body from harm. Among Imperials, the host body was known as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]]. ===Race against doomsday=== {{Quote|I've also learned the Emperor is on Dromund Kaas. His efforts against us have weakened him. Our enemy is vulnerable—for now. The Emperor is determined to destroy the galaxy. It's him, or us.''"
"''You must face the Emperor again. And this time, you cannot fail.|The Hero of Tython and Satele Shan|}} [[File:Council_Meet_Scourge.png|thumb|left|280px|Scourge betrayed the Emperor and allied with the Jedi Order in order to ensure the future he had foreseen.]] In [[3641 BBY]],{{TOR_dates|Treaty}} the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the Empire and the Republic, largely thanks to the Republic's [[Battle of the Maelstrom|freeing]] of Revan—in his captivity, Revan had used the mental link between him and his captor to temper the Emperor's desire to destroy the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Maelstrom Prison}} As war broke out, the Emperor began preparations to repeat his ritual on a galactic scale, intending to consume the entire galaxy as he had Nathema. [[3640 BBY|Around a year later]], he dispatched a number of Sith and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] agents to various worlds in order to perpetrate a mass death of thousands of beings, as his ritual would require a sacrifice to begin. However, Scourge betrayed the Emperor and sought out the Jedi from his vision, a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the Hero of Tython. Scourge informed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of the Emperor's plans and allied with the Hero in an effort to prevent the ritual. With Scourge's aid, the Hero foiled the Emperor's efforts on the planets''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Voss]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and the Emperor's agent on Corellia, the Dark Jedi [[Tol Braga]], gave the Hero the Emperor's coordinates on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. With the Emperor's location in hand, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] decided that the time was right to strike against the Emperor before he could achieve the sacrifice necessary for his ritual. Therefore, she assembled a combined task force of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and Jedi [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for an assault on Dromund Kaas and tasked the Hero and their crew of allies with infiltrating the capital and eliminating the Emperor. ==The operation== ===Invading Dromund Kaas=== {{Quote|One of the Emperor's private shuttles is not far from here. It has full security clearance to enter the temple.''"
"''Great. Now all we have to do is fight through a city of bad guys trying to kill us.|Scourge and Kira Carsen|}} [[File:Crew_aboard_ship.png|thumb|right|300px|The Hero of Tython's companions plan the mission aboard their ship.]] Upon arriving in the [[Dromund system]], the Republic task force immediately engaged the Imperial [[First Defense Fleet]], drawing the majority of the Imperial forces in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to them. Under cover of the fighting, the Hero's crew entered Imperial airspace and landed their [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class light corvette]] on the outskirts of [[Kaas City]]. The Hero's crew consisted of six individuals—the Hero, Lord Scourge, Jedi Knight [[Kira Carsen]], the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], the [[Republic trooper]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]]. Acting on Scourge's knowledge of the [[City/Legends|city]], the group determined that the easiest way to the Emperor, who was located in the edifice known as the [[Dark Temple]] in the nearby [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], would be to steal [[Sith Emperor's shuttle|one]] of the Emperor's private [[Imperial shuttle|shuttles]] that were docked in the city. The group broke up into three pairs of two and fought its way through Kaas City, which at the time was lightly guarded by [[Imperial soldier]]s, [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], including a massive [[Imperial Ravager Droid]]. All three pairs made it safely to the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], where they discussed their plan of attack before departing. Because of the Emperor's power, none of the others could safely accompany the Hero into battle with the Emperor for fear of being controlled; however, because T7-O1 was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]], he could face the Emperor without being in danger of manipulation. The other four would engage the temple's defenders in order to draw opposition away from the Hero and T7-O1 and clear their path to the Emperor. Scourge [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] the shuttle to the Dark Temple, which the six stormed to battle the dozens of [[Imperial Guard]]smen and [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] who guarded the edifice and their Emperor. {{GameLS}} Despite the enemy's numbers, the Hero and T7-O1 soon reached the stairs to the upper levels, where the Emperor waited; however, as T7-O1 interfaced with the temple security system and deactivated the [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that blocked the stairwell, he detected that one of the Hero's companions was about to be overwhelmed by Imperial Guard reinforcements nearby. Unwilling to let one of the others be killed for the sake of the mission, the pair rushed to their ally's aid, eliminating the numerous Imperial Guards and rescuing their companion before returning to the stairwell and continuing toward the Emperor. Confident in his power, the Emperor awaited the Hero's arrival in one of the temple's upper chambers and was unconcerned when the Jedi and T7-O1 succeeded in breaching his sanctum. ===A fated confrontation=== {{Quote|I will not be contained. I cannot be redeemed. Death is all that remains, and you will not kill me. […] I will not be your trophy. If I must die, I choose how—and everything dies with me.|The Sith Emperor|audio=VitiateDefinitelyDiesHere.flac|}} [[File:Emperor_attacks.png|thumb|left|300px|The Emperor charges the Hero.]] The Sith greeted his enemy with a bolt of [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], mocking the Hero for sacrificing strength to rescue an ally. The Hero intercepted the lightning with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade, and the Emperor then summoned three [[Dopplegänger|phantom duplicates]] of himself that attacked the Knight and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as the Emperor descended from his [[Throne/Legends|throne]] to confront his enemy. The pair made quick work of their phantom opponents, and when the Hero then questioned the Emperor's desire to consume the galaxy, the Emperor scoffed at what he saw as the Jedi's limited grasp of reality—he intended to outlast everything, and there were more galaxies and universes for him to conquer beyond their own. The Sith then summoned several more duplicates of himself and drew his own [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and the numerous Emperors attacked their opponents. The Emperor and his copies utilized Force lightning and Sith magic as well as their lightsabers in battle, disappearing and reappearing throughout the chamber to toy with the Jedi's senses. However, the Hero and T7-O1 stood strong against their opponents, and one by one the Emperor's duplicates fell until the remaining duplicates vanished in swirls of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy as the true Emperor fell to his knees. The Hero charged the Emperor, intending to end their battle, but the Sith ruler unleashed an explosive blast of Force lightning that threw his enemy across the room. Acknowledging the Hero's strength in the Force, the Emperor cast another burst of Force lightning directly at the Jedi, only for them to catch the attack on the blade of their lightsaber. [[File:T7_and_the_Emperor.png|thumb|right|250px|T7-O1 destroys one of the Emperor's phantoms.]] As the Emperor continued to generate lightning, the two enemies advanced on each other from across the room, but when they reached each other, the Hero spun out of the way of the lightning and dealt the Emperor a devastating blow to his waist. The Sith ruler collapsed to the floor. However, as he tried—and failed—to rise, he declared that he would never be contained or redeemed and scoffed at the Hero's claims that he would be taken to Tython and turned from the dark side. The Hero then contacted Scourge and reported success, but Scourge warned his ally that the Emperor was not yet dead. {{Endgame}} Scourge was correct—the Emperor's essence left his fallen Voice and, warning the Hero that he would take his enemy with him if he was going to die, released a massive amount of dark side energy from the Voice as a final act of defiance. The released energy severely damaged the Dark Temple, causing the upper levels to begin collapsing, and the Hero and T7-O1 rushed out of the temple to safety. The pair met up with the other members of their group, who had all survived their battle with the temple's defenders, and flew the Emperor's shuttle back to Kaas City and boarded their own waiting [[Starship/Legends|ship]] outside of the capital. Upon lifting off, the Hero immediately contacted the Grand Master and reported the mission's success, leading Shan to order a general retreat from the Dromund system. ==Aftermath== ===Political ramifications=== {{Quote|Yet that is not why I stand before you. Instead, I can finally confirm what many have suspected for months: The Sith Emperor is dead.''"
"''A Jedi strike team confronted the Emperor during a recent attack on Dromund Kaas. Now a joint SIS and Jedi committee has concluded that the galaxy's greatest villain is gone forever.''"
"''This does not change the fight ahead. The Dark Council remains the true political power in the Empire. But it sends a message to the Sith and their followers: We are coming for you.|Supreme Chancellor Saresh and Satele Shan, in a HoloNet announcement|{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Revenge of the Archon|Makeb}}}} {{GameLS}} The remaining ships of the task force rendezvoused at the Republic [[Valor-class cruiser|cruiser]] [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']] near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], where [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dabrin]] of the Republic Navy and the Grand Master arranged an [[Valiant award ceremony|award ceremony]] for the Hero and crew. All of the group received the [[Cross of Glory]], the Republic's highest honor, and Shan elevated the Hero to the rank of Jedi Master. {{Endgame}} With the loss of his Voice, the Emperor's essence retreated to his true body, where he entered restorative hibernation to recover from his battle with the Hero. Rumors of the Emperor's death spread among the upper levels of the Sith Empire, leading the maverick Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]]—already disgusted with the Empire's anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] policies and the infighting exemplified by the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]—to rebel at the [[Battle of Ilum]] not long afterward. Seizing the [[Emperor's Fortress|Emperor's abandoned space fortress]], Malgus declared a [[New Empire]], splitting the forces of the Empire as many defected to his cause.{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}} [[File:Republic_leaders.png|thumb|left|250px|Supreme Chancellor Saresh announces to the galaxy that the Emperor has been defeated.]] The New Empire was crushed at the Battle of Ilum by both the Republic and the Empire, but the damage was done—combined with the recent loss at the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Empire, which had previously held the upper hand in the Galactic War, was gradually forced on the defensive. The veteran Dark Councilor [[Darth Marr]] eventually assumed a leadership role in the Empire and made efforts to restore Imperial supremacy,''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' but it was not until around [[3638 BBY]],{{TOR_updates|2.0}} after the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] failed [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of the planet [[Makeb]], that Marr halted the Empire's losses when he acquired the powerful [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[isotope-5]].{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20140407|text=State of the Galaxy}} The details of the Dromund Kaas operation, as the event came to be known, were highly classified by the Republic. The newly elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, [[Leontyne Saresh]], refrained from announcing the operation to the public initially, but she immediately adopted an aggressive stance against the Empire, appointing the veteran [[Republic soldier|soldier]] [[Jace Malcom]] as [[Supreme Commander]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as part of an effort to take the fight to the Empire. A joint committee of Jedi and agents of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, was tasked with confirming the Emperor's death. As the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], his most trusted servants, were tasked with guarding the Emperor's body, only they and the [[Empire's Wrath|new Emperor's Wrath]] were aware of the Emperor's survival; thus, the committee's conclusion was that the Emperor was indeed dead. In the aftermath of the Republic's victory over the Hutt Cartel at Makeb, the Chancellor, Shan, and Malcom held an official announcement of the Emperor's death on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. ===The galaxy at large=== {{Quote|The Emperor was strong. He spoke to us. Guided us. Now the Emperor is quiet. None who remain are worthy of our loyalty.|The Dread Masters|}} The Emperor's essence was severely injured by the battle with the Hero and thus was forced into hibernation in his original body. While he [[Sleep/Legends|slumbered]], his consciousness reached out to his [[Children of the Emperor|Children]]—agents of the Emperor's will who were mentally linked with their "father." The Emperor's pain and anger led him to issue crazed and conflicting commands to his children, such as "[[Water/Legends|freeze]] the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]" and "set [[Fire/Legends|fire]] to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]," calling for the destruction of{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Emperor's Orphans|Voss}} entire worlds. Unable to handle the influence of their injured Emperor, a number of Children were driven near insane; others managed to shut out their master's commands, shielding themselves from his damaging influence until he healed. [[File:Dread_Masters_2.4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Dread Masters, no longer under the Emperor's control, attempted to enact their will upon the galaxy.]] The Emperor's apparent death and resultant hibernation had another major effect on the galaxy: the six Sith Lords known as the [[Dread Masters]], who had served the Emperor for centuries, were left without the Emperor's guidance and commands. Incredibly powerful in the Force, the Dread Masters found that none in the Empire were powerful enough to command their loyalty and thus decided to make the galaxy their own. Wielding their power over fear and the minds of others, the Dread Masters gathered an [[Dread Host|army]] of their own and set about acquiring exotic technology from [[Species/Legends|species]] such as the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]], becoming a third power in the Galactic War.{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130913|text=A Record of the Dread Masters}} Their attacks on [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] led the Hutt Cartel to try and expand their borders in order to make up for lost territory, and the Hutt Cartel's expansions led to the death of the Cartel's [[Supreme Mogul]], [[Karagga]].{{TORcite|type=operation|Karagga's Palace}} Karagga was succeeded as Supreme Mogul by [[Toborro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who instigated the Hutt invasion of Makeb{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/making-rise-hutt-cartel-part-2-conflict-makeb|text=Making of Rise of the Hutt Cartel Part 2: Conflict on Makeb}} in 3638 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Shortly afterwards, the remaining Dread Masters sank into insanity and decided to destroy the galaxy, though they were ultimately [[Dread War|defeated]] at the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]].{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=operation|Dread Palace}} In the depths of [[Wild Space]], the Sith Emperor's biological daughter, [[Vaylin]], discovered that the mental barriers her father had installed in her mind to prevent her from utilizing her full power were gone. With that discovery, Vaylin began plotting her revenge against her father.{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Vaylin}} The Emperor's spirit went on to serve as a major player in the galactic conflicts that followed,{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}} although it was not until{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Odessen}} [[3626 BBY]]{{TOR_updates|6.2}} that his spirit was finally vanquished for good. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The dark side has cast its shadow over you. I sense your anger and ambition growing. I can no longer ignore it. I wanted so much for you to become a Jedi Master, but you are not ready.|Satele Shan, to a dark side player|}} [[File:Hero_of_Tython.png|thumb|left|200px|The player character used to depict the operation in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia'']] The Dromund Kaas operation served as the focus of the Jedi Knight class's finale mission, "Doomsday," in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[December]] [[2011]],{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20111213-0|text=Welcome to ''Star Wars'': The Old Republic!}} although it first appeared as a vision to Lord Scourge in the prequel novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published on [[November 15]], 2011.{{Twitter|DrewKarpyshyn|status/71583440352456704|[[Drew Karpyshyn]]|quote=I'm a day late with the Tweet, so I figure I owe you something else: the official release date for Revan is Nov 15!|archivedate=20200816114517}} The mission is identified as the "Dromund Kaas operation" by the droid [[RL-4]], who introduces the Karagga's Palace Operation for Republic players, and ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' features Chancellor Saresh's official announcement of the Emperor's death. In "Doomsday," the player is presented with the choice of saving an imperiled companion, gaining [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points, or continuing on to fight the Emperor, thus depriving the Emperor the chance to gather more strength and gaining dark side alignment points. The companion in question will be the companion with which the player has the highest Affection points, excluding Lord Scourge and T7-O1, and there is no difference in difficulty in the fight with the Emperor between the two choices. If the player does not rescue the companion, then the character is rescued by one of the player's other companions. At the award ceremony, the player will either be awarded the rank of Jedi Master or [[General/Legends|general]] depending on whether the player has a light or dark side alignment score, respectively. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic-class character, this article assumes that the player chooses the option that results in the most light side points; thus, the Hero of Tython is assumed to have rescued the companion and became a Jedi Master. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Dromund Kaas operation}} *''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' {{Ab|The Old Republic: Revan (audiobook)}} {{1st}} {{Vision|Scourge}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stp}} {{1stID|Dromund Kaas operation}} *''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' {{Ab|The Old Republic: Annihilation (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' *{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150903|text=To Battle With Darkness}} *{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211104|text=Star Wars™: The Old Republic - The Story So Far}} *{{TORYouTube|PlvIpD49V8k|Star Wars™: The Old Republic - The Story So Far}} ==Notes and references== {{ScrollBox|content={{Reflist}}}} {{GalacticWarNav}} {{RitualCrisisNav}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Dromund Kaas (3641 VSY) |fr=Bataille de Dromund Kaas |pl=Atak na Dromund Kaas }} [[Category:Battles of Dromund Kaas]] [[Category:Battles of the Emperor's ritual crisis]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
